findings.message: contains 1 line(s) longer than 500 characters (possible minified/obfuscated code)
findings.remediation: Review extremely long lines; they may contain hidden logic.
findings.impact: Extremely long lines hide obfuscated or minified code from human review.
findings.attack_vector: Lines > 500 chars — code is structured to evade visual inspection.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: references 3 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records within the granted scope.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants a named write scope; exploitability depends on whether untrusted code reaches that job.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.remediation: Remove install-time side effects or document and review each lifecycle script.
findings.impact: Install-time lifecycle scripts run before the package is reviewed at runtime and inherit installer privileges.
findings.attack_vector: package.json declares preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare code that npm may execute during installation.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: dependency cordis-fabric downloads a remote archive
findings.remediation: Prefer registry packages with lockfile integrity or pin remote archives by immutable digest.
findings.impact: Mutable remote archives can change without a package version or lockfile integrity update.
findings.attack_vector: A dependency spec downloads an HTTP(S) tarball or zip directly from a mutable URL.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: invokes a file-system mutation API (2 calls in this file)
findings.remediation: Require explicit user approval and restrict mutations to an allowlisted workspace path.
findings.downgrade: Downgraded from high: no system-impact pattern matched near the call site.
findings.impact: Unbounded file-system mutations can overwrite critical files, install backdoors, or corrupt data.
findings.attack_vector: writeFile/mkdir/chmod without workspace boundary check — path is not validated against workspace root.
findings.risk_adjustment: Explicit risk (medium) set by caller; evidence-based risk adjustment skipped.

findings.message: uses obfuscation libraries or eval-like patterns with code generation
findings.remediation: Avoid obfuscation at install time; keep runtime code inspectable.
findings.impact: Obfuscation or minification tooling can conceal generated behavior from source review.
findings.attack_vector: Runtime or install-time code generation uses an obfuscation/minification package.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
